introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Stan-Baculescu Law Firm (hereinafter referred to as "the Firm", "we" or "our") is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you visit our website or use our legal services.

dataCollected.title: 2. Personal Data Collected
dataCollected.content: We collect the following categories of personal data:

items.item1: Identification data: first name, last name, email address, phone number
items.item2: Contact data: postal address, correspondence address
items.item3: Browsing data: IP address, browser type, pages visited, visit duration (through cookies, with your consent)
items.item4: Voluntarily provided data: information submitted through the contact form or in legal service requests
items.item5: Data necessary for legal representation: information relevant to legal files, if you become a client of the firm

purpose.title: 3. Purpose of Data Processing
purpose.content: We process your personal data for the following purposes:

items.item1: Providing requested legal services and managing the contractual relationship with clients
items.item2: Responding to inquiries and requests received through the contact form
items.item3: Improving the website and user experience (with your consent for analytics cookies)
items.item4: Fulfilling legal obligations, including tax and accounting requirements

retention.title: 4. Retention Period
retention.content: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected. Contact form data is retained for 2 years. Client data is retained according to professional legal obligations (minimum 10 years from the end of representation). Analytics cookies expire according to the terms specified in the Cookie Policy.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights
rights.content: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights:

items.item1: Right of access: you can request information about the personal data we hold about you
items.item2: Right to rectification: you can request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
items.item3: Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten"): you can request deletion of data in certain circumstances
items.item4: Right to restriction of processing: you can request limitation of how we use your data
items.item5: Right to data portability: you can request transfer of data to another controller
items.item6: Right to object: you can object to processing in certain situations

thirdParties.title: 6. Sharing with Third Parties
thirdParties.content: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. We may share data in the following situations:

items.item1: With service providers who help us operate the website (e.g., hosting, web analytics) - they are contractually obligated to protect the data
items.item2: With competent authorities when required by law
items.item3: To protect our rights, property, or safety, or that of third parties

contact.title: 7. Contact
contact.content: For any questions or requests related to this Privacy Policy or to exercise your rights, you can contact us at the email address office@stanbaculescu.ro or at our office at Str. Decebal Nr. 4, Et. 1, Mun. Satu Mare, Jud. Satu Mare.

This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, what types of cookies we use, and how you can manage them.

whatAreCookies.title: 2. What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device (computer, tablet, mobile phone) when you visit a website. They allow the site to recognize your device and store information about your preferences or previous actions. Cookies do not contain directly identifiable personal information and cannot access or damage your device.

essentialCookies.title: 3. Essential Cookies
essentialCookies.content: These cookies are strictly necessary for our website to function and cannot be disabled. They are set in response to your actions, such as setting privacy preferences or selecting language. Without these cookies, the site cannot function properly.

cookieConsent.purpose: Stores your consent for the use of cookies

analyticsCookies.title: 4. Analytics Cookies
analyticsCookies.content: These cookies allow us to measure and analyze how visitors interact with our website. They help us understand which pages are most popular, how visitors navigate the site, and if they encounter errors. All data collected by these cookies is aggregated and anonymous. We use Google Analytics for this purpose.

marketingCookies.title: 5. Marketing Cookies
marketingCookies.content: Currently, our website does not use marketing or advertising cookies. If we introduce such cookies in the future, we will update this policy and request your consent before activating them.

manageCookies.title: 6. How to Manage Cookies
manageCookies.content: You have full control over the cookies you accept. You can manage your preferences in the following ways:

items.item1: Through the consent banner: On your first visit to the site, a banner is displayed allowing you to accept all cookies, reject non-essential ones, or customize your choice.
items.item2: Through cookie settings: You can access cookie settings at any time from the website footer to change your preferences.
items.item3: Through browser settings: Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. Consult your browser's help section for instructions.
items.item4: Important: Disabling essential cookies may affect the proper functioning of our website.

retention.content: Essential and preference cookies are stored for 1 year. Analytics cookies (Google Analytics) are stored for 2 years. You can delete cookies at any time from your browser settings or by revoking consent through the cookie settings on our website.
